points.guidance: One mark for the ethyl ion formula; brackets are optional. Positive charge required in this authored scheme.
One mark for the formula of the oxygen-containing fragment; brackets are optional. Positive charge required. Do not accept $\mathrm{C_4H_{11}^+}$: it exceeds the parent molecule hydrogen count.

9701_s24_22_q05_b_i.label: Independently authored scheme — not an official Cambridge mark scheme

points.text: A: O–H bond, hydroxy / alcohol group. B: C=O bond, carbonyl / ketone group.
points.guidance: Award one mark only when all four table cells are correct; no fractional marks. This all-four-cells rule is independently authored, not verified against a Cambridge rubric. Do not accept carboxyl for B: X lacks the broad carboxylic-acid O–H absorption.

9701_s24_22_q05_b_ii.label: Independently authored scheme — not an official Cambridge mark scheme

points.guidance: Accept displayed, skeletal or unambiguous condensed structural formula showing the ketone connectivity. A name alone is insufficient because the question asks for a structure. Do not accept butanoic acid or butanal. Excess oxidant under reflux rules out an aldehyde end product; the spectrum has C=O but no broad O–H absorption.

9701_s24_22_q05_c_i.label: Independently authored scheme — not an official Cambridge mark scheme

points.guidance: Accept tertiary alcohol. The functional group is hydroxy; tertiary classifies the carbon bearing it.

9701_s24_22_q05_c_ii.label: Independently authored scheme — not an official Cambridge mark scheme

points.guidance: Correct products and balancing are jointly required for one mark. Accept equivalent formula ordering, a correct structural formula for either sodium alkoxide, or half coefficients: $\mathrm{C_4H_{10}O}+\mathrm{Na}\rightarrow\mathrm{C_4H_9ONa}+\tfrac12\mathrm{H_2}$. State symbols are not required.
